atoms.a: Where can instructions with bullet points often be seen?

feedback.finish: Rather than bullet points, academic writing typically presents information in structured paragraphs.

instruction.text: Read these instructions on how to assemble a desk and drag them into the correct order.

elements: • Firstly, ensure you have all the necessary tools and materials.
• Secondly, connect the legs, crossbars, and all support pieces.
• Next, attach the desktop to the assembled frame using screws or bolts.
• Finally, double-check all connections and slot in the drawers!

instruction.text: Read these instructions on how to build a train with building blocks and drag them into the correct order.

elements: • First of all, gather all the train pieces from the set.
• Secondly, assemble the train’s base and wheels.
• Afterwards, attach the train cars and ensure it is secure.
• Lastly, add any accessories to customise!

instruction.text: Read these instructions on how to make a peanut butter and jam sandwich and drag them into the correct order.

elements: • Firstly, gather the ingredients: bread, peanut butter, and jam.
• Secondly, spread peanut butter evenly on one slice of bread.
• Next, spread some jam on another slice of bread.
• Finally, put the slices together to form a sandwich and enjoy!

instruction.text: Read these instructions on how to make vegetable skewers and select the imperative verbs within the instructions.

trainers.hint: Imperative verbs are verbs used to give commands, orders, or instructions.

atoms.b:
Preparation:
• ((Wash)) the vegetables thoroughly.
• ((Chop)) them into equally sized chunks.
• ((Drizzle)) oil over them and ((push)) them onto a stick.

Cooking Process:
• ((Heat)) up the barbecue coals.
• ((Add)) the skewers to the grill.
• ((Turn)) occasionally for 5 minutes until cooked.
